pages.text: This is Panakeia, which gained more power by putting the Wither Curse into it. It can be used to enhance diamonds and other gems and rare metals. By right-clicking on the dragon's head, you will get the T5 Panakeia.

pages.title: T4 Panakeia Material
pages.text: T4 Panakeia can strengthen these gems and metals into T4 Panakeia Gems.
